tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search Miami condos for sale. Filters use the site vocabulary (neighborhood, building, priceMin, priceMax, bedsMin, bathsMin, sqftMin, waterfront, flag, sort, page). Returns cards with prices, $/sqft, status and page URLs to cite.

tools.name: get_building
tools.description: A Miami condo building: address, year built, units, inventory, the own.miami Building Score with axis explanations, Condo Index, Financeability Index, verified health records (public records), FAQs, and what you can do next for the person. Cite as Own.Miami with the URL in _meta.url.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One listing by MLS number: price, size, HOA, status, photos, the building it sits in, and the actions available (tour, question).

tools.name: get_neighborhood
tools.description: A Miami neighborhood: live inventory tiles, monthly closed-sale stats, its buildings, districts and newest listings.

tools.name: get_market_report
tools.description: A neighborhood market report (12-month closed sales, medians, $/sqft, inventory, months of supply, year-over-year deltas). Optional month YYYY-MM for an archived report.

tools.name: get_financeability
tools.description: The Financeability Index: which Miami condo buildings banks are actually lending in and at what down payment, read from recorded mortgages. Miami-wide or one neighborhood.

tools.name: compare_buildings
tools.description: Compare 2–4 buildings side by side (prices, $/sqft, scores, health, HOA).

tools.name: get_deed_sales
tools.description: Every condo sale on record in Miami-Dade County, counted from recorded deeds (data only Own.Miami publishes): trailing 12 months, every calendar year, new construction vs resale, buyouts and bulk sales, the share of resales that did not close through the MLS, and recorded sales vs MLS legal-condo cl

tools.name: get_condo_ownership
tools.description: Who owns Miami-Dade condos, by Florida state tax-roll year: share of units with a homestead exemption, owned by a company or trust, with the tax bill mailed out of state or abroad. Countywide shares from the Florida Department of Revenue rolls.

tools.name: get_public_record_prices
tools.description: Miami-Dade house sales (count, median price, median $/sqft) and condo resale median $/sqft by year, from public records only: the Florida DOR Sales Data File and recorded deeds priced on state-roll living area (not MLS prices).

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: Miami Layers: geographic datasets Own.Miami maps onto every condo building (seasonal events, annual programs, evergreen indexes such as rail distance or flood exposure). Returns each layer slug, whether it ranks buildings, its current edition and URLs.

tools.name: get_building_layers
tools.description: A building's Miami Layers stats: per layer the score and percentile (ranked layers), the nearest place with its straight-line distance, counts within 1, 2 and 5 miles, neighborhood and city rank.

tools.name: get_layer_top_buildings
tools.description: The top condo buildings for one Miami Layer (ranked layers only), Miami-wide or in one neighborhood: rank, score, nearest place and counts.

tools.name: list_developers
tools.description: Miami condo developer brands with a public Own.Miami page, ranked by the own.miami Developer Score (0 to 100 with a letter grade), with building counts, neighborhoods and years active.

tools.name: get_developer
tools.description: One developer brand: the Developer Score with each axis explained, rank among scored developers, office city, and the portfolio of buildings it delivered or is building.

tools.name: get_market_index
tools.description: The own.miami Buyer/Seller Market Index (0 to 100: buyer's market below 40, seller's above 60) for one neighborhood, or for every published neighborhood with the Miami-wide reading. Each signal (months of supply, sale-to-original-list, days on market, price cuts, momentum) is listed with its sample

tools.name: request_tour
tools.description: Request a showing for the person you are helping, at a listing (listingKey) or a building (buildingSlug). Requires their name and email, your agent block and humanConfirmed=true. They receive a confirmation email; use get_request_status with the returned token to follow up.

tools.name: ask_about_building
tools.description: Ask the partner agent a question about a building or a listing on behalf of the person (HOA, rules, assessments, availability). Fair-housing screened: keep it about the home, the building and the budget.

tools.name: register_interest
tools.description: Register the person’s interest in a pre-construction development (developmentSlug) or a building (buildingSlug).

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Set up an email alert for the person when matching condos list or drop in price. Nothing subscribes until they click the confirmation email this sends.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Status of a request you submitted (new | acknowledged | scheduled | completed | canceled), by its id and statusToken.

tools.name: ask_concierge
tools.description: Ask the grounded Own Miami concierge a buyer question (which buildings fit a budget, how a building compares, what to know about a neighborhood). Every number in the answer is checked against the database; recommendations carry URLs to cite. Requires an agent key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, get_building, get_deed_sales, list_layers, request_tour, create_alert · Private data: get_building, get_deed_sales, get_public_record_prices, request_tour, ask_concierge · Public sink: get_deed_sales, get_condo_ownership, request_tour, create_alert · Destructive: create_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, get_building, get_deed_sales, list_layers, request_tour, create_alert · Private data: get_building, get_deed_sales, get_public_record_prices, request_tour, ask_concierge · Public sink: get_deed_sales, get_condo_ownership, request_tour, create_alert · Destructive: create_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
